notes.title: Table Top Racing: World Tour Rolls Onto PC
notes.content:
If racing games are about simulating real life experiences behind the wheel, then it must be said that few have captured reality in the same way Codemasters’ Micro Machines did. It may not have been the greatest of games when it released back in 1991, but it did recreate a pre-school past time with aplomb (in my young mind, at least): driving miniature plastic cars around hand-crafted makeshift tabletop courses. Take a dash of that and add the frantic projectile-tossing of Mario Kart and you’ve got something that resembles Table Top Racing: World Tour [official site]. It’s out now.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Keyboard configuration and controller detection fixes patch
notes.content:
We have tried to quickly respond to some reports of input problems from the community:

We have fixed a bug that was preventing the redefine keys page from functioning correctly.

We have added partial support for more types of controllers (previously only Xbox and DS4s were detected). We plan to support further controllers specifically as we get access to them if required. We think that most standard XInput controllers should now be supported. If your pad has both DirectInput and XInput modes, make sure it is set to XInput.

The update is now live.
